name: io.github.WYRE-AI/kpn-mcp
title: KPN Grexx
description: MCP server for KPN IRMA on Grexx: OAuth client-credentials and realtime XML (address checks, prequalification, line diagnostics, customers, orders, mobile SIM/usage/settings, portings). Legacy developer.kpn.com tools stay off unless KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Grexx API username. Passed to the SDK as the OAuth client_id (portal: API Gegevens). The SDK sends it with HTTP Basic on the token endpoint. This server does not mint the token.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Grexx API password. Passed to the SDK as the OAuth client_secret (scope=all). The SDK sends it with HTTP Basic on the token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Grexx interface root, without /realtime. Env only — never a gateway header. No default; acceptatie and production differ.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: OAuth token endpoint. Env only — never a gateway header. Production will differ from acceptatie.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also register the developer.kpn.com tools (disturbances, availability, SIM swap, MSM). Default is Grexx only.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Legacy developer.kpn.com project client ID. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Legacy developer.kpn.com project client secret. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1, together with KPN_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_MSM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional legacy MSM app ID. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1. Must be paired with KPN_MSM_CLIENT_SECRET.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_MSM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional legacy MSM app secret. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1, together with KPN_MSM_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy developer.kpn.com base URL. Env only. Used only when KPN_LEGACY_DEVELOPER_API=1.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads KPN_GREXX_* locally, 'gateway' expects X-KPN-Grexx-Username and X-KPN-Grexx-Password. Base URL and token URL stay env-only.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
